ja: 設定を保存して終了する。

key: Expect me back some day. Self improvement isn't something one can just stop working at.
en: Expect me back some day. Self improvement isn't something one can just stop working at.
ja: またいつか来る。自分を鍛えることに、終わりはないからな。

en: Game speed multiplier while in Turbo Mode. Higher values require Frame skip to work.

key: Go inside to update the events.
en: Go inside to update the events.
ja: イベントを更新するには中に入ること。

key: Good. That's a performance to be proud of.
en: Good. That's a performance to be proud of.
ja: よし。誇っていい戦いぶりだったわ。

key: Hah! You did all right this time, but you better not get comfy!
en: Hah! You did all right this time, but you better not get comfy!
ja: ハッ! 今回はまあまあだったな。だが調子に乗るなよ!

key: Hah. Fair enough. Good show.
en: Hah. Fair enough. Good show.
ja: ハッ。納得だ。いい戦いだった。

key: Hello again, Champion. I know we just fought... but I've got something different I'd like to try.
en: Hello again, Champion. I know we just fought... but I've got something different I'd like to try.
ja: また会ったね、チャンピオン。戦ったばかりだけど……ちょっと違うことを試してみたいんだ。

key: Hello, Champion! I'm here for a routine inspection for the sake of the League... And by that I mean, put 'em up!
en: Hello, Champion! I'm here for a routine inspection for the sake of the League... And by that I mean, put 'em up!
ja: こんにちは、チャンピオン! リーグのための定期検査に来ました……つまり、構えてください!

key: Hey! You already beat me once, but I got bored since then so you better be ready for take-off time 2!
en: Hey! You already beat me once, but I got bored since then so you better be ready for take-off time 2!
ja: ねぇ! 一度は負けたけど、あれから退屈しちゃって。第2回・離陸のお時間、覚悟しなさいよ!

key: Hey, bet you never thought you'd see me here! I've got a lot of lost time to make up for, so I'm gonna do my best!
en: Hey, bet you never thought you'd see me here! I've got a lot of lost time to make up for, so I'm gonna do my best!
ja: ねぇ、ここでわたしに会うなんて思わなかったでしょ! 遅れを取り戻さなきゃいけないから、全力でいくよ!

key: Hey, take care of yourself, okay? I can't have you losing before I beat you!
en: Hey, take care of yourself, okay? I can't have you losing before I beat you!
ja: あの、体に気をつけてくださいね? わたしが勝つ前に負けられたら困りますから!

key: Hey, thought you could use help warming this place up. What do you say, wanna redecorate?
en: Hey, thought you could use help warming this place up. What do you say, wanna redecorate?
ja: ねぇ、ここを暖めるのに手を貸そうかと思って。どう、模様替えしない?

key: Heyyyyy Champ, thought you might be bored!
en: Heyyyyy Champ, thought you might be bored!
ja: やっほ〜チャンピオン、退屈してるんじゃないかと思ってさぁ!

key: Hides private information for safety and compatibility.
en: Hides private information for safety and compatibility.
ja: 安全性と互換性のために個人情報を隠す。

key: I can come back, right? You'd better be ready for me next time!
en: I can come back, right? You'd better be ready for me next time!
ja: また来てもいいよね? 次は覚悟しといてよ!

key: I finally made it! You, and my brother, and everyone else... I'm gonna prove how strong I can be now!
en: I finally made it! You, and my brother, and everyone else... I'm gonna prove how strong I can be now!
ja: ついにここまで来ました! あなたにも、兄さんにも、みんなにも……わたしがどれだけ強くなれたか、証明してみせます!

key: I guess you've got it handled. Maybe I'll come back around sometime.
en: I guess you've got it handled. Maybe I'll come back around sometime.
ja: ちゃんとやれてるみたいだね。またそのうち顔を出すかも。

key: I'll be back next time I drop in on my sister. Stay sharp.
en: I'll be back next time I drop in on my sister. Stay sharp.
ja: 姉さんのところに寄るとき、また来るわ。気を抜かないで。

key: I'll see you around. The top dog? Doesn't stay down long.
en: I'll see you around. The top dog? Doesn't stay down long.
ja: またな。トップに立つ男は、そう長くは沈まねえんだよ。

key: I'm so excited I could make it this far!
en: I'm so excited I could make it this far!
ja: ここまで来られて、すごくうれしい!

key: Include eggs in the search?
en: Include eggs in the search?
ja: 検索にタマゴを含めますか?

key: Invalid version.
en: Invalid version.
ja: バージョンが正しくない。

key: It feels good to be keenly aware of my standing. Thank you for the extra time.
en: It feels good to be keenly aware of my standing. Thank you for the extra time.
ja: 自分の立ち位置がはっきり分かるのは気持ちがいいね。時間を取ってくれてありがとう。

key: It was probably inevitable that we'd find ourselves here. Let's make sure you haven't gone soft.
en: It was probably inevitable that we'd find ourselves here. Let's make sure you haven't gone soft.
ja: こうなるのは避けられなかったんでしょうね。あなたが鈍っていないか、確かめさせてもらうわ。

key: It's good to do this on our own terms! Just like so long ago, right?
en: It's good to do this on our own terms! Just like so long ago, right?
ja: こうして自分たちのやり方で戦えるのはいいですね! ずっと昔と同じように、でしょう?

key: It's good to see that the future is in good hands. I look forward to being a part of it alongside you~
en: It's good to see that the future is in good hands. I look forward to being a part of it alongside you~
ja: 未来が確かな手にゆだねられていると分かって安心したよ。君と共にその一部でいられるのが楽しみだ〜

key: It's surreal to see you here. Surreal to be here. How about it, then?
en: It's surreal to see you here. Surreal to be here. How about it, then?
ja: お前がここにいるのは不思議な気分だ。俺がここにいるのもな。それで、やるか?
